_comment: Which LM Studio model runs each Filing Desk role. reader = digest the transcript, extract facts, outline the parts; writer = the story parts; json = summary/aftermath/verdict, guards and edit plans. context = the context length to load it with (null = keep LM Studio's). swap = unload the other models before loading a role's model (one GPU). Bake-off 2026-11-07: qwen3.5-9b extracts and outlines ~4x faster than Gemma with valid JSON, but as a writer it ignored part scope and asides; gemma-4-12b-qat kept scope, verbatim lines and the WAH! aside; anubis-mini-8b writes rich prose but broke the rules.
